summary: Re-ran the two suite failures alone: both pass, so they are order/state dependent flakes in the full suite, not reproducible failures. I did no further exploratory play this session.

failures.what: Rain shower test: critters' actions all the same in the full suite (Pinchy :jump, Marshmallow :idle, only 2 distinct actions)
failures.steps: Run the full suite; the shower test runs after earlier tests. Alone (live_tests 'Rain shower') it passes in 43 s.
failures.expected: At least 3 different actions among critters 4 s into a shower
failures.actual: Only two critters were in s.roles with 2 distinct actions (jump, idle): probably few free critters left over from earlier tests (can_join) or roles that are not visible as distinct actions at that instant

failures.what: Creatures overlap in the full suite: Pickles and Sir Sniffsalot 1.34 m apart (below 0.95*(r1+r2))
failures.steps: Run the full suite; the test only waits 5 frames after pushing one creature into another. Alone it passes.
failures.expected: Separation keeps all creature pairs apart
failures.actual: A pair not involved in the teleport (Pickles, Sir Sniffsalot) was still overlapping: likely an interaction (chat/shower/dance) holding them close, or Separation giving the push to only one creature at the shore
